blurb: ////County of Barrhead encompasses many scenic lakes, rivers, and forests. Overnight camping opportunities abound! Many privately-owned campgrounds can be found throughout the County, as well as two provincial park/recreation areas. Additionally, the County operates & maintains four overnight campgrounds on a first-come first-serve basis.
